note: Machine-readable conformance contract. The palette is NOT listed here — it is derived from tokens.css at check time, so this file can never drift from the source of truth. Enforced by validators/check-system-conformance.js.

forbiddenColors.reason: Kiln is fired clay, not print. The darkest value is --kiln-ground-lo and the lightest is --kiln-ink; pure black and pure white break the warm cast the whole system depends on.

typefaces.reason: Three faces, three jobs. A fourth family, or a generic first entry, dissolves the system's voice.

elevation.reason: Elevation is a four-property stack, not a blur. Any surface that needs depth uses one of the three levels; an inline box-shadow means a fourth, undeclared level exists.

accent.reason: The ember is the only saturated thing in Kiln. Beyond about three solid-filled elements in one document it stops marking the primary action and becomes the page's colour scheme.

texture.reason: Grain is not decoration here — it is what keeps large warm fills from banding and reading as flat vector.
